verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API and publishes an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it-now examples. The schema is only a building block a developer could load into their own tooling. The public sandbox is described as a product-UI demo, not an environment for testing API calls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API"
